newsitem.title: USA: Motorola signs $200 mln contract in China.
newsitem.headline: Motorola signs $200 mln contract in China.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Wednesday its Asia Pacific Cellular Infrastructure Group (APCIG) signed a $200 million contract to supply cellular equipment and services in China.

Under the agreement, Motorola APCIG will provide Total Access Communications System (TACS) equipment and services to Eastern Communications Co Ltd of China and Zhejiang Technical Import and Export Corp.
The contract will enable Eastern Communications to expand its manufacturing and distribution of Motorola's TACS cellular infrastructure equipment, Motorola said.
"This is the seventh TACS contract between our three companies," Tom Hinton, vice president and assistant general manager of Motorola APCIG, said in a statement.

Since 1991, Motorola APCIG has entered into licensing and joint venture agreements with Eastern Communications and Zhejiang Technical to manufacture, distribute and provide service for Motorola's TACS, Code Division Multiple Access and Global System for Mobile Communications cellular infrastructure products within China.
Motorola provides wireless communications, semiconductors and advanced electronic systems, components and services.
